t: Evo-Stik Sticks Like Sh*t is a robust, solvent-free grab adhesive, perfect for demanding construction and repair jobs. This clear, synthetic polymer-based adhesive bonds exceptionally well to porous, non-porous, and wet surfaces, even performing underwater. It is ideal for plumbers and builders working on interior and exterior projects, such as installing bathroom fixtures or securing outdoor trim, where high strength and water resistance are essential. With low odour and paintable features, it offers a versatile and durable solution, drying within 12-24 hours. Its excellent vertical bonding strength ensures secure fixes every time.
